vibe_rationale: Curated, multi-format, after-dark culture festival spanning club, food, art and cold-water ritual, trusted by its community and the closest SURPLUS peer in scope.
fit_notes: Adult alternative arts and club crowd with a strong self-care hook in the solstice swim and floating sauna, though past partners were mostly government and tourism. High Ground would need a culture-first role such as a recovery or warm-up presence around the sauna and swim strands, approached through Mona rather than billboard sponsorship.
